## Conocimiento pendiente de promoción (a wiki)
- Wikipedia's betting tables (Quiero/No quiero cumulative) are the most precise source for envido scoring — preferable over the simplified "1 point" rule in the main trucoGame.com page
- "Mano mata a Pie" applies as envido tie-breaker even within the same team ordering; it's a positional rule, not a card-strength rule
- "El envido está primero" survives playing cards: as long as not all 4 first-round cards are played, envido can still be sung after truco
- Wikipedia is a strong cross-reference for edge cases the trucoGame.com source glosses over; recommend keeping both sources cited
